headline: Turning
data into
stories.
hero.intro: Journalism, visualization and design — three lenses on the same truth. I turn analysis into stories people actually read.

work.note: Charts with a reason to exist
work.closingNote: Selected work, not a complete archive.

about.note: From raw data to finished story
about.approach: R is my primary tool for statistical computing, modeling and data wrangling, with SQL and Python close behind. D3.js and ggplot2 do the drawing — custom interactive SVGs for the web, publication-quality charts for print.
about.philosophy: Data journalism, information design and visual narrative are the whole point: the skills that turn an analysis into something people actually read. Design tools and a bit of motion take care of the last mile.

headline: Have data
worth telling?
contact.intro: A dataset, a question or a story that needs a shape. Tell me where you'd like to go — we'll work out how to get there.
